description: record_version values a verifier accepts or rejects, for the TransactionRecord (Section 9.5, step 1) and the SessionEvidenceRecord (Sections 9A.2 and 9A.6). Producers emit producers_emit; the AuditLog carries its version in log_version. Both suites take a valid record of each kind, set record_version to each value (a rejected case with no record_version key removes the key), recompute record_hash and, for the SessionEvidenceRecord, the producer seal, and assert the verdict: every accepted value verifies, and every rejected value fails verification instead of being parsed best-effort. The TransactionRecord is the record transaction-record-basis.json replays to. The SessionEvidenceRecord is the record session-evidence-record-parity.json produces, resealed with that file's producer_private_jwk.
